verses.text: <ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>链<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>式<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>做<ruby>链<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>顶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby>做<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>榴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>链<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>左<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>斤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>左<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>波<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bō</rt></ruby><ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ā</rt></ruby><ruby>斯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>铜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>；
verses.heading: 圣殿的设备

verses.text: <ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>铸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>铜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>式<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>圆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>径<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>周<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>瓜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuā</rt></ruby>（“<ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>瓜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuā</rt></ruby>”<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>式<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>瓜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>共<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>铸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>铸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>铜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>驮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuó</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby>：<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>北<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>东<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>尾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wěi</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>掌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>花<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>千<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>罢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bà</rt></ruby><ruby>特<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tè</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>盆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pén</rt></ruby>：<ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>左<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>沐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>浴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>式<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>：<ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>左<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>张<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>桌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuō</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>：<ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>张<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>张<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>左<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>碗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎn</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>铜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>包<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bāo</rt></ruby><ruby>裹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>扇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby>；
